mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS is declining relative to its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and housing market momentum, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive equity returns; the effect is only significant when both series rise together.
failure_condition: The joint rise of RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rising labor force participation rate (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals robust job market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly and UNRATE < 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO is above its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5% annually, it triggers central bank tightening expectations that increase real interest rates and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL annual rate > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in the money supply (CPIAUCSL growth) indicates a coordinated monetary policy easing that lowers real interest rates and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days; the effect is only significant when both conditions occur together.
failure_condition: The joint movement of FEDFUNDS decline and CPIAUCSL growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances, or the interaction term in a regression model has a p-value > 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high industrial production regime (INDPRO > 105), a decline in manufacturing capacity utilization (INDPRO growth < 0.2% monthly) signals weakening supply chain conditions that reduce corporate margins and lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 105 and INDPRO growth < 0.2% monthly, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
